verdict.rationale: Docs show prospect/pending customer creation, KYC/KYB verification, and enhanced due diligence for supplying additional info (docs-9, docs-18, docs-19, docs-28), plus a general platform claim of operational workflows and 'complete data visibility and seamless collaboration' between integrator and bank partner (docs-16, docs-17) and case notifications for employees (docs-27). However there is no explicit onboarding queue UI, no documented 'reason for pending' surface, and no clear articulation of which decisions belong to ops vs the bank. Missing for 10: dedicated queue/dashboard view, explicit pending-reason display, explicit decision-ownership boundary documentation.
